title: Gitea activity correlation pack
notes: Tracks authentication, admin changes and unusual repository activity on pilot-web-01.
Suppression key: host.name + service.name + rule family.

stream_rules.title: Gitea Failed Login Burst
stream_rules.operator_action: Review failed principals, client IP and whether the failures align with expected SSO rollout or abuse.
stream_rules.sigma_yaml:
title: Gitea Failed Login Burst
id: sigma-gitea-failed-login-burst
status: experimental
logsource:
  product: application
  service: gitea
detection:
  selection_source:
    host.name: pilot-web-01
  selection_message:
    message|contains:
      - Failed authentication attempt
      - invalid credentials
      - authentication failed
  condition: selection_source and selection_message
level: medium

stream_rules.title: Gitea Administrative Change
stream_rules.operator_action: Validate the admin action against change control and confirm the actor has the expected grant scope.
stream_rules.sigma_yaml:
title: Gitea Administrative Change
id: sigma-gitea-administrative-change
status: experimental
logsource:
  product: application
  service: gitea
detection:
  selection_source:
    host.name: pilot-web-01
  selection_message:
    message|contains:
      - admin user changed
      - auth source updated
      - repository deleted
      - user promoted to admin
  condition: selection_source and selection_message
level: high

stream_rules.title: Gitea Repository Activity Spike
stream_rules.operator_action: Check whether clone, push or repository creation volume is expected for the current maintenance or migration window.
stream_rules.sigma_yaml:
title: Gitea Repository Activity Spike
id: sigma-gitea-repository-activity-spike
status: experimental
logsource:
  product: application
  service: gitea
detection:
  selection_source:
    host.name: pilot-web-01
  selection_message:
    message|contains:
      - repository created
      - repository deleted
      - git push
      - git clone
  condition: selection_source and selection_message
level: medium
